sample_unit: subjects (758 training/internal validation from NIFD and ADNI; 89 external validation)
models_evaluated: XGBoost classifier with automated deep-learning brain MRI volumetry

links.outcome: Reader accuracy and interpretation time with versus without algorithm assistance
links.effect: Experienced readers maintained accuracy with significantly reduced reading time (p < 0.001) with algorithm assistance; the underexperienced reader's accuracy improved with no significant change in interpretation time (p = 0.786).
links.quote: Among experienced readers, accuracy was maintained, with a significant reduction in reading time (p < 0.001) when assisted by the algorithm.

links.outcome: Performance drop from internal validation to external real-world hospital validation
links.effect: Accuracy fell from 91.40% internal to 88.80% external; sensitivity from 87.02% to 82.87%; AUC from 95.41% to 92.94%; FTD-specific external sensitivity was 61.07% (95% CI 38.45-84.01).
links.quote: FTD-specific sensitivity and specificity in the external validation cohort were 61.07% (95% CI, 38.45-84.01) and 97.13% (95% CI, 92.86-100.00), respectively.

screen.reason: The study conducts a reader study comparing radiologists' diagnostic performance and reading time with versus without AI assistance.
